messages.subject: Error in import shapefile
parts:
Hi all,

is anyone can help me to fix this error when I try to import a shapefile that I want to use in my density estimation?

 library(sf)
> shppiana <- system.file("Piana_Poly.shp", package = "secr")
> piana <- st_read(shppiana)
Error: `dsn` must point to a source, not an empty string.

I suppose that the problem is when I use system.file
But also I don't understand why the function st_read doesn't work.

Thank you 

Emiliano

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in import shapefile
parts:
Emiliano
system.file(..., package="secr")  will only get you files that are distributed with the package.
Compare

[1] ""
>system.file("extdata/possumarea.shp", package = "secr")
[1] "C:/R/R-4.0.5/library/secr/extdata/possumarea.shp"

Just give st_read the (full) file name you want to read.

Murray
